notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, certified candidate list and certified questions and issues list; issue wording is from the Board's ballot issues document. Long charter amendments are condensed; the full wording is on the sample ballot.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.

Issue 17 (City of Madeira, Sunday sales in precinct Madeira D) was withdrawn on September 24, 2026 and is not on the ballot. Local issue numbers start at 4: Issue 3 is the statewide question, and there are no Issues 1 or 2.

issues.title: Charter amendment (as reported by City Council)
issues.text: Shall the proposed charter amendment as reported by the city council of the City of Harrison be adopted?

issues.title: Charter amendment: modernizing the Charter (Articles II–VIII, X–XIV, XVI and XVII)
issues.text: Amend fourteen articles of the Charter to: modernize terminology and gender references and add continuity and severability provisions; allow electronic notice of special Council meetings while raising minimum notice from 24 to 48 hours; clarify Council vacancy language; let Council appoint a qualified person to perform the Manager's duties during an extended absence; eliminate the Charter-created Treasurer office, with the Manager authorizing expenditure warrants; have Council and the Manager agree each year on a threshold above which contracts and purchases need Council approval, and revise contract notice and bid provisions; revise the Planning Commission's authority and duties and let it and the Board of Zoning Appeals skip meetings when there is no business; and replace the Charter's automatic protection of the Hosbrook House, Muchmore House and Railroad Depot with protection only for properties on the National Register of Historic Places or designated historic by City ordinance.

levy.estimate: $1,642,311 a year; $47 for each $100,000 of the county auditor's market value

issues.title: Charter amendment: Charter Review Commission recommendations
issues.text: Rename the City Treasurer the Finance Director (Section 5.02); retitle Article VI "Commissions and Boards"; eliminate the Civil Service Commission sections (6.01, 6.02); drop the "for cause" requirement for removing board and commission appointees and move that section (11.03) and the virtual-meetings section (11.08) to Article VI; add a new Section 6.03 on establishing other commissions and boards; clarify that all City elections are non-partisan (Section 8.01); and make the oath of office gender neutral (Section 11.07).
